messages:
tariq: quick follow-up from the postmortem \u2014 we need concrete owners and short timelines for GPU capacity/autoscale remediation. proposing a lightweight tracker + weekly 30m sync.

maya: i can own scheduler tuning. plan: baseline in 3 business days, conservative tunables in 9 days, validate in 14. will coordinate test harness with eng-infra.

anita: i'll own quota/vendor uplift. opening cloud + vendor tickets today. target initial responses in 2-4 business days; will flag any spend approvals.

sam: i'll draft the headroom + surge runbook. first draft by day 5, tabletop at next sync. includes rollbacks and escalation ladder.

opsbot: created task REM-3120 and recurring event "GPU Remediation Weekly" (Weds 09:30 PT). reminder 24h prior.

metrics-bot: incident snapshot: peak GPU util 99%, sustained queue latency at p99. current cluster free headroom 7%. snapshot saved to s3://incidents/gpu/2073000000/snap.json

```
Action checklist (confirm owners/dates):
- QUOTA UPLIFT: owner=anita, due=+3d, steps=[open tickets, estimate lead-time, escalate cost approvals]
- SCHEDULER TUNING: owner=maya, due=+14d, steps=[perf baseline, apply conservative tunables, validate under 60-80% load]
- HEADROOM RUNBOOK: owner=sam, due=+7d, steps=[draft runbook, tabletop, automation hooks]
- DASHBOARDS & ALERTING: owner=tariq, due=+2d, steps=[headroom gauges, surge thresholds]
```

tariq: i'll stand up the tracker and invite owners. if you need test GPUs or reserved ephemeral capacity, say so here.

maya: requesting 4 ephemeral gpus for A/B tuning tests next week.

anita: noted. i'll include cost estimates in tracker. tagging finance for approvals.

sam: runbook will include simple commands for immediate mitigation and a checklist for canary validation.

opsbot: REM-3120 updated: subtasks assigned to owners. next sync created with agenda template.

metrics-bot: 72h headroom projection: 6% free GPUs assuming current traffic trend; recommend burst pool pre-warm before known peaks.

tariq: great. first sync next Weds, we'll review baselines and vendor responses. update tracker with blockers. thanks everyone.
